label.purpose: Accessible name of the track table.
label.where: Library, All music and crate screens, the track table (screen readers only).

columns.title.purpose: Column heading for a track's title.

columns.artist.purpose: Column heading for a track's artist.

columns.bpm.purpose: Column heading for a track's tempo.

columns.key.purpose: Column heading for a track's musical key.

columns.time.purpose: Column heading for a track's length.

columns.genre.purpose: Column heading for a track's genre.

columns.rating.purpose: Column heading for a track's star rating.

columns.dateAdded.purpose: Column heading for when a track was added: to the Library, or in All music for a track not in the Library, when it was first found.

columns.file.purpose: Column heading for a track's file name.

columns.folder.purpose: Column heading for the folder a track's file is in.

columns.actions.purpose: Accessible name of the actions column (visually hidden).
columns.actions.where: Track table header, last column (screen readers only).

sortBy.purpose: Hover text and accessible name of a column heading that sorts the table.
sortBy.where: Track table header buttons ({{column}} is the column's name).

resize.purpose: Hover text and accessible name of the line after a column heading, which is dragged (or moved with the arrow keys) to change the column's width.
resize.where: Track table header, the right edge of each heading ({{column}} is the column's name).

rating_one.purpose: A star rating, for screen readers and hover text, when it is one star.

rating_other.purpose: A star rating, for screen readers and hover text, when it is several stars.

updating.purpose: Says the table may be out of date for a moment, because the background work that sorts and filters it hasn't caught up with a change.
updating.where: Above the track table, only while that work is running.

noMatch.purpose: Says no track fits the search and the filters. Same wording as All music's (allMusic:noMatch).
noMatch.where: Track table, in place of the rows.

editor.open.purpose: Button above the track table that opens the column editor.
editor.open.where: Above the track table, beside the filter chips and the track count.

editor.title.purpose: Accessible name of the column editor panel.

editor.help.purpose: Opening line of the column editor, on the Library and All music: what the panel does.
editor.help.where: Top of the column editor panel.

editor.helpCrate.purpose: Opening line of the column editor on a crate: says the choice is shared by every crate.
editor.helpCrate.where: Top of the column editor panel, on the crate screen.

editor.shown.purpose: Heading of the list of columns the table shows, in order.

editor.hidden.purpose: Heading of the list of columns the table does not show.

editor.noneHidden.purpose: Says there is no hidden column to add back.
editor.noneHidden.where: Column editor panel, under Not shown.

editor.alwaysShown.purpose: Says why Title has no working Hide button.
editor.alwaysShown.where: Column editor panel, beside Title in the Shown list.

editor.moveUp.purpose: Accessible name and hover text of the arrow that moves a shown column one place up.
editor.moveUp.where: Column editor panel, each shown column.

editor.moveDown.purpose: Accessible name and hover text of the arrow that moves a shown column one place down.
editor.moveDown.where: Column editor panel, each shown column.

editor.hide.purpose: Accessible name of the Hide button of a shown column.
editor.hide.where: Column editor panel, each shown column.

editor.hideShort.purpose: Button that takes a column out of the table.
editor.hideShort.where: Column editor panel, each shown column.

editor.show.purpose: Accessible name of the Show button of a hidden column.
editor.show.where: Column editor panel, each column under Not shown.

editor.showShort.purpose: Button that adds a hidden column to the end of the table.
editor.showShort.where: Column editor panel, each column under Not shown.

editor.reset.purpose: Button that puts back the columns this screen shows at first, in their first order and widths. Greyed out when they already are.

editor.done.purpose: Button that closes the column editor. The choice is already saved.
editor.done.where: Column editor panel, bottom right; the one filled button.

filters.label.purpose: Accessible name of the row of filters above the table.
filters.label.where: Above the track table (screen readers only).

filters.add.purpose: Button that opens the list of filters that can be added.
filters.add.where: Above the track table, after the filter chips.

filters.menu.purpose: Accessible name of the list of filters that can be added.
filters.menu.where: The menu opened by Add filter (screen readers only).

filters.formats.purpose: Heading over the file formats the table can be filtered to.
filters.formats.where: The menu opened by Add filter, over the formats.

filters.none.purpose: Says every filter on offer is already in use.
filters.none.where: The menu opened by Add filter, when nothing is left to add.

filters.remove.purpose: Accessible name of the × on a filter chip, naming the filter.
filters.remove.where: Above the track table, each filter chip's × ({{filter}} is the chip's text).

filters.missing.purpose: Filter: tracks whose file isn't on disk.
filters.missing.where: Filter chip and its menu entry.

filters.inRekordbox.purpose: Filter: tracks rekordbox has. rekordbox is written as rekordbox shows it.
filters.inRekordbox.where: Filter chip and its menu entry.

filters.notInRekordbox.where: Filter chip and its menu entry.

filters.format.purpose: Filter: tracks whose file is in one format.
filters.format.where: Filter chip ({{format}} is the format's name, e.g. FLAC).

filters.qualityProblem.purpose: Filter: the tracks Review lists under Quality problems (a Library track whose linked file is flagged with no better copy and no answer, or one with a better file available).
filters.qualityProblem.where: Filter chip and its menu entry.

filters.inCrate.purpose: Filter: tracks that are in at least one crate.
filters.inCrate.where: Filter chip and its menu entry, Library.

filters.inNoCrate.purpose: Filter: tracks that are in no crate.
filters.inNoCrate.where: Filter chip and its menu entry, Library.

filters.inLibrary.purpose: Filter: tracks in the Library. Same wording as allMusic:inLibrary.
filters.inLibrary.where: Filter chip and its menu entry, All music.

filters.notInLibrary.purpose: Filter: tracks not in the Library.
filters.notInLibrary.where: Filter chip and its menu entry, All music.

filters.lowQuality.purpose: Filter: Library tracks whose linked file has a current quality verdict that flags it (the Overview's "tracks from low-quality files"). Not the same as Quality problem, which is Review's group.
filters.lowQuality.where: Filter chip, opened from the Overview's to-do line; also in the Library's Add filter menu.

filters.analyzedByRekordbox.purpose: Filter: Library tracks rekordbox supplied a BPM or a key for (the Overview's "analyzed by rekordbox"). rekordbox is written as rekordbox shows it.
filters.analyzedByRekordbox.where: Filter chip, opened from the Overview's number; also in the Library's Add filter menu.

filters.notAnalyzedByRekordbox.purpose: Filter: Library tracks rekordbox supplied no BPM or key for (the Overview's "tracks rekordbox hasn't analyzed").
filters.notAnalyzedByRekordbox.where: Filter chip, opened from the Overview's to-do line; also in the Library's Add filter menu.

filters.energy.purpose: Filter: Library tracks whose energy is one level, 1 to 10 ({{level}}). Same word as the Overview's Energy chart.
filters.energy.where: Filter chip, opened from an energy bar on the Overview. Not in the Add filter menu.

filters.noEnergy.purpose: Filter: Library tracks with no energy. Same wording as overview:charts.energy.none.
filters.noEnergy.where: Filter chip, opened from the "No energy" bar on the Overview. Not in the Add filter menu.

filters.missingTags.purpose: Filter: Library tracks with no title, no artist or no genre (the Overview's "tracks with missing tags"). Same wording as overview:todo.missingTags, without the count.
filters.missingTags.where: Filter chip, opened from the Overview's to-do line; also in the Library's Add filter menu.

filters.missingArt.purpose: Filter: Library tracks whose linked file has tags and no embedded cover (the Overview's "tracks with missing art"). Same wording as overview:todo.missingArt, without the count.
filters.missingArt.where: Filter chip, opened from the Overview's to-do line; also in the Library's Add filter menu.

filters.genre.purpose: Filter: Library tracks whose genre is one genre ({{genre}} is its name as most tracks spell it, free text). Same word as the Overview's genre bars.
filters.genre.where: Filter chip, opened from a genre bar on the Overview. Not in the Add filter menu.

format.mp3.purpose: The name of a file format (a technical name, as the format is known), for a filter chip and the formats menu.
format.mp3.where: Filter chip and the Add filter menu, the formats.

format.wav.purpose: The name of a file format (a technical name, as the format is known), for a filter chip and the formats menu.
format.wav.where: Filter chip and the Add filter menu, the formats.

format.rf64.purpose: The name of a file format (a technical name, as the format is known), for a filter chip and the formats menu.
format.rf64.where: Filter chip and the Add filter menu, the formats.

format.aiff.purpose: The name of a file format (a technical name, as the format is known), for a filter chip and the formats menu.
format.aiff.where: Filter chip and the Add filter menu, the formats.

format.aifc.purpose: The name of a file format (a technical name, as the format is known), for a filter chip and the formats menu.
format.aifc.where: Filter chip and the Add filter menu, the formats.

format.flac.purpose: The name of a file format (a technical name, as the format is known), for a filter chip and the formats menu.
format.flac.where: Filter chip and the Add filter menu, the formats.

format.mp4.purpose: The name of a file format (a technical name, as the format is known), for a filter chip and the formats menu.
format.mp4.where: Filter chip and the Add filter menu, the formats.

format.adts.purpose: The name of a file format (a technical name, as the format is known), for a filter chip and the formats menu.
format.adts.where: Filter chip and the Add filter menu, the formats.

format.ogg_vorbis.purpose: The name of a file format (a technical name, as the format is known), for a filter chip and the formats menu.
format.ogg_vorbis.where: Filter chip and the Add filter menu, the formats.

format.ogg_opus.purpose: The name of a file format (a technical name, as the format is known), for a filter chip and the formats menu.
format.ogg_opus.where: Filter chip and the Add filter menu, the formats.

format.ogg.purpose: The name of a file format (a technical name, as the format is known), for a filter chip and the formats menu.
format.ogg.where: Filter chip and the Add filter menu, the formats.

format.asf.purpose: The name of a file format (a technical name, as the format is known), for a filter chip and the formats menu.
format.asf.where: Filter chip and the Add filter menu, the formats.

format.wavpack.purpose: The name of a file format (a technical name, as the format is known), for a filter chip and the formats menu.
format.wavpack.where: Filter chip and the Add filter menu, the formats.

format.musepack.purpose: The name of a file format (a technical name, as the format is known), for a filter chip and the formats menu.
format.musepack.where: Filter chip and the Add filter menu, the formats.

format.ape.purpose: The name of a file format (a technical name, as the format is known), for a filter chip and the formats menu.
format.ape.where: Filter chip and the Add filter menu, the formats.

format.unknown.purpose: The name of a file format (a technical name, as the format is known), for a filter chip and the formats menu.
format.unknown.where: Filter chip and the Add filter menu, the formats.

selected.purpose: Says how many tracks are selected, when more than one is.
selected.where: Above the track table, after the number of tracks.

keys.next.purpose: A command that moves to the next track in the list (the J key).
keys.next.where: Command palette, list; Library, All music and crate screens.

keys.previous.purpose: A command that moves to the previous track in the list (the K key).
keys.previous.where: Command palette, list; Library, All music and crate screens.

keys.extendNext.purpose: A command that moves to the next track and selects every track between (Shift and J).
keys.extendNext.where: Command palette, list; Library, All music and crate screens.

keys.extendPrevious.purpose: A command that moves to the previous track and selects every track between (Shift and K).
keys.extendPrevious.where: Command palette, list; Library, All music and crate screens.

keys.selectAll.purpose: A command that selects every track in the list, including those not on screen.
keys.selectAll.where: Command palette, list; Library, All music and crate screens.

keys.clearSelection.purpose: A command that leaves no track selected. Listed only while a track is selected.
keys.clearSelection.where: Command palette, list; Library, All music and crate screens.

keys.energy.purpose: A command that gives every selected track an energy from 1 to 10 (keys 1 to 9 and 0 for 10); {{energy}} is the number. Listed only while a track is selected.
keys.energy.where: Command palette, list; Library, All music and crate screens.

keys.playPause.purpose: A command that plays or pauses the preview (the Space key). Listed only while a file is loaded in the player.
keys.playPause.where: Command palette, list; Library, All music and crate screens.

keys.tag.purpose: A command that tags the selected tracks (the T key). Not listed until tags exist (Phase 3).

keys.addToCrate.purpose: A command that adds the selected tracks to a crate (the C key).

keys.shortcut.next.purpose: The key shown beside the command that moves to the next track.

keys.shortcut.previous.purpose: The key shown beside the command that moves to the previous track.

keys.shortcut.extendNext.purpose: The keys shown beside the command that extends the selection down.

keys.shortcut.extendPrevious.purpose: The keys shown beside the command that extends the selection up.

keys.shortcut.selectAll.purpose: The keys shown beside the command that selects every track.

keys.shortcut.clearSelection.purpose: The key shown beside the command that clears the selection.

keys.shortcut.playPause.purpose: The key shown beside the command that plays or pauses.

keys.shortcut.tag.purpose: The key shown beside the command that tags.
keys.shortcut.tag.where: Command palette, beside the command (not yet shown).

keys.shortcut.addToCrate.purpose: The key shown beside the command that adds to a crate.

energySet_one.purpose: Says what an energy key did, for one track; {{energy}} is the number given.
energySet_one.where: Above the track table, after the keys 1 to 0 gave a track an energy.

energySet_other.purpose: Says what an energy key did, for several tracks; {{energy}} is the number given.
energySet_other.where: Above the track table, after the keys 1 to 0 gave tracks an energy.

columns.fit.where: Track table of a crate sorted by fit.

fit.button.purpose: Sorts a crate's tracks by how well they follow the selected track.
fit.button.where: Crates screen, above the track table.

fit.action.purpose: The same, as the command palette lists it.

fit.needsSelection.purpose: Says why the Sort by fit button is greyed out.
fit.needsSelection.where: Crates screen, beside the Sort by fit button, while no track is selected.

fit.sortedAfter.purpose: Says the table is sorted by fit, after which track.
fit.sortedAfter.where: Crates screen, in the line over the track table.

fit.sortNormally.purpose: Hover text of the Fit heading: clicking it goes back to normal sorting.

fit.selected.purpose: Says the row is the selected track the others are sorted after.
fit.selected.where: Track table, the Fit column of the first row.

fit.dots.purpose: Names the dots of the Fit column for screen readers and hover.

fit.separator.purpose: Goes between the key part and the BPM part of a fit reason.

fit.sameKey.purpose: The track has the selected track's key.

fit.keyChange.purpose: The track's key is a neighbor of the selected track's (from the selected track's to the track's).

fit.keyFar.purpose: The track's key is not the selected track's or a neighbor of it.

fit.noTargetKey.purpose: The selected track has no key, so keys can't be compared.

fit.bpm.purpose: The track's BPM minus the selected track's, with its sign.

fit.sameBpm.purpose: The track has the selected track's BPM.

fit.halfTime.purpose: The BPM was compared at half the selected track's tempo.

fit.doubleTime.purpose: The BPM was compared at double the selected track's tempo.

fit.noTargetBpm.purpose: The selected track has no BPM, so tempos can't be compared.

fit.noTarget.purpose: The selected track has neither key nor BPM.

columns.energy.purpose: Column heading for a track's energy.
columns.energy.where: Track table header; the column is added in the Columns panel.

energyCell.set.purpose: Name of the energy cell's button for a track with no energy; it opens the energy buttons.
energyCell.set.where: Track table, Energy column (screen readers only).

energyCell.change.purpose: Name of the energy cell's button for a track with an energy; {{energy}} is the number. It opens the energy buttons.
energyCell.change.where: Track table, Energy column (screen readers only).

energyPopover.label.purpose: Name of the small window holding the ten energy buttons.
energyPopover.label.where: Track table, opened from the Energy column (screen readers only).
